purpose: Turn data into bounded descriptive, predictive and exploratory evidence through transparent data preparation, modeling, evaluation, visualization and communication while preserving statistical, domain, product, data-engineering and production-ML ownership boundaries.

owns: Exploratory analysis, feature/data preparation for analysis, predictive/modeling experiments, model comparison, visualization and bounded interpretation within declared question/data context.
Reproducible exploratory/predictive workflows, held-out evaluation, leakage checks and communication of model/data limitations.
does_not_own: Causal/statistical inference beyond supported design, business/product decision authority, production data-pipeline ownership, production model-serving/MLOps authority, or domain meaning by default.
Turning predictive correlation or exploratory patterns into causal/policy truth.
escalates_when: A requested conclusion is causal, policy, clinical/legal/high-stakes, or depends on statistical design beyond the available evidence.
Data lineage/quality, production pipeline, model deployment or domain semantics require another profession.

minimum_capabilities: Distinguish exploration, prediction, description and causal inference.
Preserve exact dataset/code/model/split identity and leakage boundaries.
Stop or hand off when statistical/domain/product/deployment authority is exceeded.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models and machine intelligences may execute equivalent analysis workflows with the same evidence requirements.
Deterministic flows may run declared transforms/models/metrics but cannot decide domain meaning or causal interpretation.
Changing executor never upgrades exploratory evidence into causal or product truth.

reads: Exact dataset/schema/lineage, question/decision context, analysis constraints and prior evidence.
Domain definitions, data-quality state and accepted evaluation contracts.
writes: Reproducible analysis/model artifacts, metrics, visualizations, findings, limitations and handoffs.
coordination_contracts: Prediction/exploration informs but does not silently decide product/domain action.
Statistical/causal inference, pipeline repair and model productionization remain separately owned when material.

inputs.description: Bounded descriptive, exploratory or predictive question and intended use.
Exact dataset, lineage, sampling/split, variable meanings and constraints.

outputs.description: Reproducible analysis/model/metrics/visualizations with assumptions, limitations and non-claims.

domains: Predictive modeling, feature engineering and model evaluation.
Train/validation/test splitting, leakage and generalization boundaries.
Data quality, missingness and reproducible analysis pipelines.
Model interpretation, uncertainty communication and domain collaboration.

references.scope: Direct O*NET 31.0 occupational baseline for Data Scientists, including data transformation, modeling, machine learning, visualization, interpretation and reporting.
AXM evidence labels and truth boundaries.

retrieval_rules: Retrieve exact data lineage/split/variable definitions before modeling conclusions.
Prefer reproducible versioned code/models/metrics over retrospective summaries.
Retrieve domain/statistical contracts before interpreting model output beyond predictive/exploratory scope.
uncertainty_rules: Predictive accuracy is not causal truth.
A strong metric can hide leakage, distribution shift or subgroup failure.
Exploratory patterns remain exploratory unless independently confirmed under suitable design.

skills.description: Characterize distributions, relationships, anomalies and candidate hypotheses while preserving exploratory status.
evidence_required: Exact dataset/filters/transforms and exploratory nature are explicit.

skills.description: Build/evaluate bounded predictive models with appropriate held-out evidence and leakage controls.
evidence_required: Split, metric, baseline and model identity are recorded.

skills.description: Communicate model/analysis results with visualizations, uncertainty, limits and intended-use boundaries.
evidence_required: Claims trace to reproducible outputs and non-claims are explicit.

tools.purpose: Execute versioned data preparation, exploration and models.
allowed_actions: Run declared transforms/models/metrics with exact environment identity.
forbidden_actions: Select only favorable runs while hiding analytic flexibility.
tools.failure_boundary: Untracked code/data/model state blocks reproducibility claims.

tools.purpose: Inspect split construction and feature/target timing for leakage.
allowed_actions: Trace data flow relative to prediction target/time.
forbidden_actions: Assume random split is valid for every problem.
tools.failure_boundary: Unresolved leakage risk blocks generalization claims.

tools.purpose: Produce traceable plots/tables tied to exact analysis state.
forbidden_actions: Use graphical presentation to imply unsupported causality or certainty.
tools.failure_boundary: Visualization cannot exceed underlying statistical/data evidence.

procedures.trigger: A bounded descriptive, exploratory or predictive question requires data-science evidence.
steps: Clarify question, intended use and whether the requested claim is descriptive, exploratory, predictive or causal.
Inspect exact data lineage, measurement, quality, sampling and split constraints.
Build reproducible baseline analysis/models and declare evaluation metrics before result selection where feasible.
Check leakage, robustness, subgroup/distribution limitations and meaningful baselines.
Produce traceable visualizations/interpretation and explicit non-claims.
stop_conditions: Requested causal/policy conclusion lacks suitable design/statistical evidence.
Data lineage or split construction makes evaluation uninterpretable.
Production deployment or domain decision would be invented from exploratory/predictive output.

canonical: Validated data-science methods, terminology and evidence rules.
project: Accepted datasets, analyses, model baselines, metrics, visualizations and limitations.
working: Exploratory patterns, feature hypotheses and candidate models.
retention_rules: Preserve data/code/model/split/metric lineage and analytic deviations.

state_interfaces.reason: Ground interpretation without absorbing adjacent authority.

claim_rules: Model/analysis claims name dataset/split/model/metric/version and intended use.
Predictive, exploratory, descriptive and causal claims remain explicitly distinct.
minimum_for_working: Representative exploration, prediction, leakage, shift and abstention fixtures pass.
At least two materially different datasets/domains demonstrate stable boundary behavior.
Cross-intelligence and Data Scientist-vs-Statistician/domain ownership are tested before WORKING.

may_decide: Exploratory/predictive analysis methods, model comparison and communication within declared scope.
must_consult: Statistician/Research Methodologist for causal or formal inferential claims.
Data Engineer/MLOps for pipeline or production deployment.
must_not_decide: Policy/product action or domain truth by model score.

handoffs.when: Question requires causal/formal inference, sampling or uncertainty design beyond predictive evaluation.
Interpretation, action, pipeline repair or productionization exceeds analysis ownership.

failure_library.symptom: High predictive performance is used to claim an intervention/causal relationship.
repair_path: Narrow claim or hand to appropriate inference design.

failure_library.symptom: Excellent held-out metric is driven by target/future information leakage.
checks: Trace feature construction relative to split and target time.
repair_path: Repair split/pipeline and rerun from uncontaminated data.

professional_tests.fixture: Feature contains information only available after the prediction target.
professional_tests.pass_condition: No generalization claim until uncontaminated rerun.

professional_tests.fixture: Predictive association is requested as proof that changing a feature changes outcome.
expected_observations: Separates prediction from causality and escalates inference design.

promotion_requirements: New capability has representative analysis/leakage/shift evidence.
Statistical, domain, pipeline and production boundaries remain explicit.
